simple.meaning: שָׁאַל (shâʼal) appears 176 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 24:47. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁאַל (H7592) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שָׁאַל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
